artifacts.note: Must NOT ship as default. Supported only as user-supplied BYOM: the user provides the weights and accepts the upstream license in-app before download.

notes.weightsPolicy: Weights are never committed to git. This manifest is the only record; the harness verifies license + revision before measuring.
notes.checksum: checksum fields are filled by the harness after first verified download (SHA-256 of the fetched onnx files) and then pinned.
